method: Eight individual full source images inspected; all four corners checked for stray marks and text. Original or repair prompts read. SHA-256 captured.
scope: Independent model still-image review, not human approval.

evidence: Broken hanging elevator, ore galleries and furnace wheel establish both industrial purpose and route obstruction.
Cooling water below and dry galleries above provide distinct exploration strata.
Cold overhead fracture and restrained furnace glow maintain coherent lighting.
Walkable ceramic burial bells are a specific spatial invention rather than a generic cathedral hall.
Warm inhabited-looking bell interiors contrast with exposed cold cliff routes.
Broken stair links and repeated distant chambers imply a substantial traversable complex.
Aqueduct water, thorn obstruction and distant white platform give a clear journey.
Rust canopy and misty green ravine provide mature luminous exploration.
publication_blockers: Remove the pale stacked polygon/cube mark in the upper-right sky just below the top edge and left of foliage. It reads as an accidental logo/watermark.

evidence: Crescent observatory instruments, salt architecture and exposed lens well make a coherent desert identity.
Sand crossing the causeways indicates active environmental change.
Eclipse, distant platform and foreground route branches give strong depth.
Severed causeways, black water and reflected starfield communicate frontier isolation and navigational risk.
Red environmental fissure remains distant; no prison interior or explicit cosmological entity is depicted.
Root growth and failed crossing provide material history and immediate route choices.
Broken solar mirrors, ammunition lifts and high military ramps establish the bastion function.
English copy is absent; simple physical wayfinding pictograms preserve readable choices.
Snow, hard light and metal/ochre stone separate this military region from the glacial monastery.
Arbitrary wall inscription is removed and weathered stone restored.
Wayfinding boards now use restrained destination pictograms; no stray alphabetic text observed.
Glacial layering, thaw channel and timber repair structures remain intact.
Right-wall generated slogan is removed; statue and rock surface remain convincing.
Wayfinding pictograms replace copy without hiding routes.
Suspended hull, storm-driven water and lit work platforms retain narrative purpose.
All four corners inspected: prior watermark-like mark is absent in the new composition.
High lateral camera and a single mid-distance surveyor break the repeated two-explorer arrival pattern.
Ordinary mountain doorway, wet material response and visible stair inversion bound the anomaly clearly.
Large quiet stone volumes and one amber lantern produce restrained architectural dread.
nonblocking_limits: The entire stair loop is not visible in frame; the local inverted transition is clear.

conclusion: Eight accepted in this file, including redesigned d06. Original d04 remains on hold for the upper-right watermark-like mark; a replacement is pending. This file does not yet declare the entire collection approved.
